biotools.summary: MetaDegron is a web service and deep-learning framework for predicting E3 ligase targeted degrons by integrating protein language models and comprehensive featurization strategies. It allows prediction of targeted degrons for 21 E3 ligases and provides functional annotations and visualization of degron-related features.
